title: High-Throughput Ticket Fan-Out: 1 Master Order to 500 Child Tickets
precondition: Master group with 500 active linked sub-accounts.
steps: 1. Master submits 50.0 lots market buy.2. Measure fan-out duration across broker bridge.
expected: All 500 child tickets created and submitted in < 150ms; zero dropped child orders; total volume == 50.00 lots.
coverage_note: Five orders x 100 followers = 500 child positions; not one order to 500 distinct followers.
